meta.title: Brand guidelines
meta.description: The Linse brand: logo, colours, typography, glass and metal materials, motion and voice, with the logo pack to download.

hero.title: Brand
hero.lead: How Linse looks, moves and speaks: one system for the site, our products and every post.

idea.title: Everything IT, under one roof
idea.lead: One team for the software, the devices it runs on and the support that keeps both working. The brand carries that idea in three ways.

night.title: Night to light
night.text: Pages open in a night green and resolve into light: complexity turned into clarity.

metal.title: Metal
metal.text: Chrome and brushed aluminium stand for hardware: things built to last.

glass.title: Glass
glass.text: Frosted and clear glass with a green glow stands for software: transparent and precise.

idea.together: Together they make a device: a metal body with a glass screen. Every hero visual uses one or both.

logo.title: Logo
logo.lead: The LS monogram and the Linse wordmark, set in Archivo SemiBold. Use the files from the logo pack; never redraw them.

tiles.mark: The mark alone: avatars, favicons, devices

space.title: Clear space
space.text: The width of the L stem on every side.

size.title: Minimum size
size.text: Mark 16 px tall; horizontal lockup 72 px wide.

legal.title: Legal name
legal.text: Linsetech Ltd, in documents, contracts and footers.

donts: Add shadows or effects other than the approved glass and metal

colour.title: Colour
colour.lead: Night carries the brand, green is the signal. Keep green to about a tenth of any layout.

gradients.glow: Glow: the night with light rising

colour.a11y: Green on night passes for text (about 8.7:1). On light backgrounds, set green text in Green 600 (#15803D); bright green is for shapes and highlights only.

materials.title: Glass and metal
materials.lead: Our two materials, rendered in a dark studio with an off-white key light and a green rim from below and behind. One hero object per visual.

chrome.title: Chrome
chrome.text: Polished, high-contrast reflections of a dark studio with a green-tinted environment. For hardware and the LS mark.

glass.title: Glass
glass.text: Frosted or clear, thick, bevelled edges catching an off-white highlight, a faint green glow inside. For software, data and cards.

materials.combined: Combined: a chrome frame holding a glass panel, the way a device holds its screen.
materials.grain: A 4–6 % film grain sits over dark visuals, never over text.

type.title: Typography
type.lead: Archivo for everything you read, Archivo Narrow in capitals for everything you scan. Both are free on Google Fonts.
type.note: Headlines are tight (leading 1.0–1.1, tracking −2 %). Kinyarwanda runs 15–20 % longer than English: leave room for it.

graphic.title: Graphic language
graphic.lead: Square corners everywhere, thin dashed lines, a small green square as a marker, and one square unit that builds grids, cards and motion.

dashed.title: Dashed lines
dashed.text: 1 px, off-white at 15 % on night, black at 15 % on light.

marker.title: Marker
marker.text: A 6 px green square pins headings and lists.

index.title: Index numbers
index.text: 01, 02… in Archivo Narrow, for steps, slides and sections.

icons.title: Icons
icons.text: Line icons, 1.5 px stroke on a 24 px grid, square caps.

motion.title: Motion
motion.lead: Things arrive fast and settle slowly. Text is revealed by line or character, 3D is scrubbed by scroll, and social loops last 6–10 seconds without a seam.

voice.title: Voice
voice.lead: We write like a good engineer explains: plainly, specifically, without hype.

plain.title: Plain
plain.text: Short sentences and everyday words. Explain the term or drop it.

specific.title: Specific
specific.text: Real numbers, real places, real steps. No numbers we can't stand behind.

confident.title: Confident
confident.text: Say what we do and how. No "revolutionary", no "best in Africa".

local.title: Local
local.text: English and Kinyarwanda, each written naturally, never translated word for word.

pairs.do: We configure every laptop before it leaves our workshop.
pairs.dont: We deliver cutting-edge, best-in-class IT solutions.

pairs.do: A technician is on critical issues within the hour.

applications.title: Applications
applications.lead: The same frame on every post: logo top left, a series label top right, a dashed footer with the address, one hero object. Night and light posts alternate, so the profile grid reads as a checkerboard.
applications.sizes: Feed 1080 × 1350 · Stories and reels 1080 × 1920 · X 1200 × 675 · LinkedIn link 1200 × 627
